Hey all, I had an idea for a sexy Christmas episode. It takes place years after Layton has transformed into Laysee. Well into Laysee's time with the Recurve program. Unfortunately for her, the recurve program needs results from it's top model/spokesperson! So they give her months of training for a unique "Christmas Job"

Stay tuned for the second comic for space pirates! I've got it cooked up, and my workflow is pretty ironed out. Let me know how I can improve the comics themselves! (be nice please! I read every comment)

Expect more for January: Recurve Chapter 2, Run(a)way Prince Ch: 1 (new sci-fi comic) and The Adventures of Captain Billie (web browser novel game) (most likely the general build and maybe the intro)

For more, check out my patreon!

Also, I know why the images are blurry and how to fix it. It's considerably more work to do this though. Need a smart way to work it into my workflow.
